title: Local H1 fibre-generator lifting after base descent
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ and $f_i:X_i\to S$ for $i\in\operatorname{Fin}(n)$ be flat, proper morphisms locally of finite presentation [def-weil-flat-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], with morphisms $u_i:X_i\to X$ satisfying $u_i f=f_i$. Assume that their structure pushforwards are universally the structure module, expressed by invertibility of the canonical unit maps after every base change [def-pc-base-change, def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $L$ be invertible on $X$ [def-sc-invertible-module], let $k:W\to S$ be an immersion, and let $w\in W$, $s\in S$ satisfy $k(w)=s$ [def-weil-residue-field]. Assume that each pullback of $u_i^*L$ to $X_i\times_S W$ is isomorphic to the pullback of a finite locally free module on $W$, and that $L$ on $X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ is isomorphic to the pullback of a finite locally free module on $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. If the joint canonical structure-sheaf cohomology map $H^1(X_s,\mathcal O)\to\prod_i H^1(X_{i,s},\mathcal O)$ is injective [def-sc-structure-sheaf-cohomology-pullback], then there is an open $V\subset W$ containing $w$, and a global section of the pullback of $L$ on $X\times_S V$, whose nonvanishing locus contains every point over the point $(w,w\in V)$ of $V$ [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. No Picard locus or intersection representation is asserted.

Obtain invertibility of the tensor pullback of L using invertible_pullback_tensor. For each marked-fibre point apply the equivalence between local generation and membership in the nonvanishing locus for that invertible pullback.

theorem picard_h1_local_section_of_base_descent {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S) {n : ℕ}
    (Xi : Fin n → Scheme.{v}) (fi : ∀ i, Xi i ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    [∀ i, Flat (fi i)] [∀ i, IsProper (fi i)] [∀ i, LocallyOfFinitePresentation (fi i)]
    (ui : ∀ i, Xi i ⟶ X) (hui : ∀ i, ui i ≫ f = fi i)
    (hO : ∀ {T : Scheme.{v}} (g : T ⟶ S),
      IsIso ((Classical.choose
        (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g))).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf)))
    (hOi : ∀ i, ∀ {T : Scheme.{v}} (g : T ⟶ S),
      IsIso ((Classical.choose
        (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd (fi i) g))).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf)))
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S) [IsImmersion k]
    (w : W) (s : S) (hw : k w = s)
    (hLi : ∀ i, ∃ (N : W.Modules) (_ : N.IsFiniteLocallyFree),
      Nonempty ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst (fi i) k)).obj
        ((Modules.tensorPullback (ui i)).obj L) ≅
        (Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (fi i) k)).obj N))
    (hLs : ∃ (N : (Spec (S.residueField s)).Modules) (_ : N.IsFiniteLocallyFree),
      Nonempty ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (S.fromSpecResidueField s))).obj L ≅
        (Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd f (S.fromSpecResidueField s))).obj N))
    (hH : Function.Injective (fun x :
        Sheaf.H (structureSheafAb (pullback f (S.fromSpecResidueField s))) 1 ↦ fun i ↦
      structureSheafCohomologyPullback
        (((Over.pullback (S.fromSpecResidueField s)).map
          (Over.homMk (U := Over.mk (fi i)) (V := Over.mk f) (ui i) (hui i))).left) 1 x)) :
    ∃ (V : W.Opens) (hwV : w ∈ V),
      ∃ σ : Γ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (V.ι ≫ k))).obj L, ⊤),
        ∀ x : (pullback f (V.ι ≫ k) : Scheme.{v}),
          (pullback.snd f (V.ι ≫ k)) x = (⟨w, hwV⟩ : V.toScheme) →
            x ∈ Modules.nonvanishingLocus
              ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (V.ι ≫ k))).obj L) σ
